title: Ondo floating header
description: A black navigation bar that floats over the page: on desktop a centred 792px bar 12px from the top with 8px corners and a huge soft shadow, holding a wordmark, four quiet nav items and a pale 'launch' button; on phones a full-width bar with the mark, the button and a menu that drops down. On load the bar opens out from its middle and its items slide in from the left.
notes: the bar forces the theme's dark colours with the dark class, so it stays black on a light page
takes no height in the flow (it overlays the next section, like a fixed bar): give the first section top room
the phone menu is a native details element: no JavaScript
